description: Bespoke Hecke-correspondence visualizer on the modular-curves topic — a prime selector picks p (2,3,5,7) and the SVG renders the p+1 order-p subgroups of E[p] together with the resulting quotient elliptic curves whose sum gives T_p[E]. The p-torsion-subgroup grid plus quotient-curve rendering is bespoke and doesn't generalize.
